tempo.drift: smooth accelerando over the whole song (see bars[].bpm)

octave_check.verdict: ~130 BPM chosen: the 2x candidate (~261) has similar ACF strength (busy 8th-note parts) but kick/snare alternate at the ~130 level (backbeat on 2 & 4); ~65 would put the snare on every beat

beat_tracking.note: beats = onset-snapped (use for hits); beats_smooth = jitter-free spline grid (same indices; use for continuous motion)

downbeat_info.notes: kick on beat phases {1,3}, snare on {0,2} -> backbeat at the ~130 BPM level; phase 1 vs 3 decided by bass-chroma change (long chords start on phase 1) and bass re-entries after breakdowns (all top jumps on phase 1). All chorus repeats are 0 mod 4 beats apart -> no odd bars.

sections_method: boundaries+labels curated from bar-level novelty (MFCC, chroma, bass in/out, stops) and aligned bar-chroma repetition; validated at run time (boundary_novelty*, repeat_similarity -> confidence)
